这是合成数学示例：曲线和表格都由同一组 `@sample` 采样记录生成，拖动滑块后会在本地更新。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[aInput,chart,table,note,reset])
$a: number = 1
let points = @sample(x => @sin($a * x), -2, 2, 9)
aInput = Slider(label="参数 a（合成数学示例）", bind=$a, min=-5, max=5, step=0.1, digits=1)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], unit="u", title="合成数学示例：y = sin(a·x)")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y（u）"}])
note = Callout(text="合成数学示例数据：曲线与表格来自同一组 [-2, 2] 上的 9 个采样点；null 结果会保留为缺口，不填零。", tone="tip")
reset = Button(label="恢复初值 a = 1", action=Reset())
```
